verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a policy or opt-out on using filers' data for AI training, so the axis applies. The only on-topic evidence is the Commission's site-wide robots.txt 'Disallow: /' on its main and CIS hosts. That is a site-level crawl restriction, an adjacent control, not a user-facing way to stop one's own data from being used for training. The Virginia Tax robots.txt belongs to a different agency and is not credited.
